158|In the year 2008, the total GDP (current US$) of the world was 64,311,729,364,641.3.
159|
160|The country with the highest GDP (current US$) was 🇺🇸[United States](/economy/united-states/gdp-current-us), with a total of 14,769,857,911,000. Closely followed by 🇯🇵[Japan](/economy/japan/gdp-current-us) with a GDP (current US$) of 5,106,679,115,127.3, and 🇨🇳[China](/economy/china/gdp-current-us) with a GDP (current US$) of 4,667,346,414,521.95 recorded.
161|
162|The country with the lowest annual GDP (current US$) was 🇹🇻[Tuvalu](/economy/tuvalu/gdp-current-us) with only 31,874,434.858 . Followed by 🇳🇷[Nauru](/economy/nauru/gdp-current-us) with a GDP (current US$) of 37,602,264.731, and 🇲🇭[Marshall Islands](/economy/marshall-islands/gdp-current-us) with 146,600,000.
163|
164|The geographic region with the highest GDP (current US$) in 2008 was [Early-demographic dividend](/economy/early-demographic-dividend/gdp-current-us) with a total of 7,461,798,613,306.43. Closely followed by [East Asia & Pacific (IDA & IBRD countries)](/economy/east-asia-pacific-ida-ibrd-countries/gdp-current-us) with a GDP (current US$) 6,054,648,571,433.55, and [Euro area](/economy/euro-area/gdp-current-us) with 14,295,718,485,782.5 for the year.
165|
166|When devided into income groups we can see that [High income groups](/economy/high-income/gdp-current-us) had the highest GDP (current US$) of 48,511,546,178,932.7. While the lowest GDP (current US$) was recorded by [Upper middle income groups](/economy/upper-middle-income/gdp-current-us) where the GDP (current US$) was only 12,105,099,178,344.4.
